#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int INF = 1000*1000*1000;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap, cost;
};

void add_edge(vector<vector<Edge>>& g, int a, int b, int cap, int cost) {
    g[a].push_back({b, (int)g[b].size(), cap, cost});
    g[b].push_back({a, (int)g[a].size()-1, 0, -cost});
}

int main() {
    int N, m, k, c, d;
    scanf("%d %d %d %d %d", &N, &m, &k, &c, &d);
    int n = N * 101 + 2;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int x;
        scanf("%d", &x);
        x--;
        add_edge(g, n-2, x*101, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
        add_edge(g, i, n-1, INF, i*c);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j+1 < 101; j++) {
            add_edge(g, i*101 + j, i*101 + j + 1, INF, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        scanf("%d %d", &u, &v);
        u--; v--;
        for (int j = 0; j+1 < 101; j++) {
            for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                int cost = d*(2*K-1);
                add_edge(g, u*101 + j, v*101 + j + 1, 1, cost);
                add_edge(g, v*101 + j, u*101 + j + 1, 1, cost);
            }
        }
    }
    int s = n-2, t = n-1;
    int flow = 0, cost = 0;
    vector<int> pot(n, 0);
    while (flow < k) {
        vector<int> dist(n, INF);
        vector<int> prevv(n, -1);
        vector<int> preve(n, -1);
        priority_queue<pair<int,int>, vector<pair<int,int>>, greater<pair<int,int>>> pq;
        dist[s] = 0;
        pq.push({0, s});
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto [d, v] = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            if (dist[v] < d) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[v].size(); i++) {
                Edge& e = g[v][i];
                if (e.cap > 0) {
                    int nd = d + e.cost + pot[v] - pot[e.to];
                    if (dist[e.to] > nd) {
                        dist[e.to] = nd;
                        prevv[e.to] = v;
                        preve[e.to] = i;
                        pq.push({nd, e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (dist[t] == INF) break;
        for (int v = 0; v < n; v++) {
            if (dist[v] < INF) pot[v] += dist[v];
        }
        int addflow = k - flow;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
            addflow = min(addflow, g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap);
        }
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
            Edge& e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
            e.cap -= addflow;
            g[v][e.rev].cap += addflow;
            cost += e.cost * addflow;
        }
        flow += addflow;
    }
    assert(flow == k);
    printf("%d\n", cost);
    return 0;
}

    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 101; i++) {
        add_rib(g, i, n-1, INF, i*c);
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < N; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j+1 < 101; j++) {
            add_rib(g, i*101 + j, i*101 + j + 1, INF, 0);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        int u, v;
        cin >> u >> v;
        u--; v--;
        for (int j = 0; j+1 < 101; j++) {
            for (int K = 1; K <= k; K++) {
                add_rib(g, u*101 + j, v*101 + j + 1, 1, d*K*K - d*(K-1)*(K-1));
                add_rib(g, v*101 + j, u*101 + j + 1, 1, d*K*K - d*(K-1)*(K-1));
            }
        }
    }
    int s = n-2, t = n-1;
    int flow = 0, cost = 0;
    while (flow < k) {
        vector<int> id(n, 0);
        vector<int> d(n, INF);
        vector<int> q(n);
        vector<int> p(n);
        vector<size_t> p_rib(n);
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        q[qt++] = s;
        d[s] = 0;
        while (qh != qt) {
            int v = q[qh++];
            id[v] = 2;
            if (qh == n) qh = 0;
            for (size_t i = 0; i < g[v].size(); ++i) {
                rib& r = g[v][i];
                if (r.f < r.u && d[v] + r.c < d[r.b]) {
                    d[r.b] = d[v] + r.c;
                    if (id[r.b] == 0) {
                        q[qt++] = r.b;
                        if (qt == n) qt = 0;
                    } else if (id[r.b] == 2) {
                        if (--qh == -1) qh = n-1;
                        q[qh] = r.b;
                    }
                    id[r.b] = 1;
                    p[r.b] = v;
                    p_rib[r.b] = i;
                }
            }
        }
        if (d[t] == INF) break;
        int addflow = k - flow;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = p[v]) {
            int pv = p[v];
            size_t pr = p_rib[v];
            addflow = min(addflow, g[pv][pr].u - g[pv][pr].f);
        }
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = p[v]) {
            int pv = p[v];
            size_t pr = p_rib[v], r = g[pv][pr].back;
            g[pv][pr].f += addflow;
            g[v][r].f -= addflow;
            cost += g[pv][pr].c * addflow;
        }
        flow += addflow;
    }
    assert(flow == k);
    cout << cost << '\n';
    return 0;
}
